paragraphs.text: Sand is a rarely used creature type , depicting creatures made up of a loose granular substance, typically pale yellowish brown. For almost thirty years it used to be token -specific and mainly combined with the Warrior type.

The type was first used for Hazezon Tamar ( Legends ) to represent the storyline that he could create Sand copies of himself. Until the printing of the Dune-Brood Nephilim , it was the only use of this token. The Nephilim is the only example where Sand-tokens are used on their own.

Hazezon would get another iteration years later in Dominaria United with the box topper Hazezon, Shaper of Sand . Sand warriors were reused again for the Thunder Junction Commander card Sand Scout , and Desert Warfare in Modern Horizons 3 .
In 2025, the creature type was first used on the type line of a non-token card, in the Universes Beyond Marvel's Spider-Man set.
